```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Climate change is a national security crisis.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America's national security has been threatened by its energy insecurity since the 1970s.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Achieving energy security in the 21st century requires more than expending economic and political resources to keep oil flowing from unstable and hostile countries and regions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Energy security requires stemming the flow of money to oil rich regimes that are hostile to America and its allies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Energy security requires combating climate change and preparing for its impacts both at home and abroad.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Energy security requires making international energy markets work for America and not against America.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Energy security requires standing up to oil companies that spend hundreds of millions of dollars on lobbying and political contributions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Energy security requires addressing nuclear safety, waste, and proliferation challenges around the world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will halt a dangerous trend and take the necessary steps to achieving energy independence.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reduce oil consumption by at least 35 percent, or ten million barrels per day, by 2030.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Reducing oil consumption by at least 35 percent, or ten million barrels per day, by 2030 will more than offset the amount of oil expected to be imported from OPEC nations in 2030.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
